edits.headline: India beat China 1-0 to win Asian Games women's hockey gold
edits.subheadline: Lalremsiami scored the only goal in the 10th minute, giving India its first women's hockey gold at the Asian Games in 44 years.
editorialBody: India's women's hockey team beat China 1-0 in the Asian Games final in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on 2 October, Organiser reported.

Lalremsiami scored the only goal in the 10th minute. The gold is India's first in women's hockey at the Asian Games in 44 years and gives the team direct qualification for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.
Christa Pike was in critical condition in hospital after Tennessee failed to execute her on 30 September, her lawyer said on 2 October, BBC News reported.
Tennessee Governor Bill Lee ordered a third-party review of what happened during the execution attempt, Al Jazeera reported.
Anwar Gargash, diplomatic adviser to the UAE president, praised flydubai captain Smit Machchhar and called the 30 September cockpit attack a "dangerous terrorist act", Khaleej Times reported.
